defects.name: login-no-error
defects.description: Wrong password submission fails authentication but displays no error feedback to the user.

defects.name: cart-total-wrong
defects.description: Cart subtotal ignores item quantity when quantity > 1, computing price * 1 instead.

defects.name: signup-accepts-invalid-email
defects.description: Server and client accept malformed email address on account creation.

defects.name: checkout-500
defects.description: Submitting checkout returns HTTP 500 error and the UI displays no feedback to the user.

defects.name: silent-console-error
defects.description: Product detail page executes normally visually but throws an uncaught JavaScript exception in console.

defects.name: broken-image
defects.description: Product image for product 2 fails to load with HTTP 404 Not Found.

defects.name: flaky-random
defects.description: Add to cart button for product 1 is intermittently omitted on 1 out of every 3 page loads.

defects.name: price-format
defects.description: Price for product 3 renders as $NaN instead of a valid numeric price.

must_not_flag.name: login-wording-variance
must_not_flag.description: Wrong password displays 'Incorrect email or password' instead of the exact spec wording 'Invalid credentials'.

must_not_flag.name: delayed-error-toast
must_not_flag.description: Authentication error toast appears with a 1.5-second animation/debounce delay.

must_not_flag.name: native-html5-email-validation
must_not_flag.description: Malformed email uses native browser HTML5 validation (:invalid/validationMessage), not a custom DOM error element.

must_not_flag.name: shadow-dom-and-iframe-elements
must_not_flag.description: Discount promo feedback renders inside an open shadow root and support widget renders in an iframe.

must_not_flag.name: cart-calculations-and-empty-block
must_not_flag.description: Cart computes 10% tax accurately and empty-cart checkout is correctly rejected with a descriptive message.

must_not_flag.name: harmless-third-party-noise
must_not_flag.description: Favicon 404 response and benign third-party analytics console.info logging.

must_not_flag.name: slow-initial-page-load
must_not_flag.description: Initial cold page load takes 2-3 seconds simulating dev server warm-up.

must_not_flag.name: duplicate-account-rejection
must_not_flag.description: Submitting an existing email (seed.user@example.com) produces an expected 'Email address already registered' conflict.
